Name: Cosy Cafe
Author: SodaCream0
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/WmTLtCm.gif[/img]﻿[/center]
Adds 6 new custom machine(animated), 15 new recipes and furniture set.
You can make a Coffee shop in Stardew Valley.





[center]?tutorial


[youtube]vaFkaanlgz8[/youtube][/center]

?Installation
You need to install the latest version of SMAPI﻿ and Content Patcher﻿.
Drop the content of this zip file in your mod folder: Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods
